title: 撒马道 Sa Ma Dao
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 道光 《季春含辉楼马射》 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 五; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春胜境御园南，电掣青骢驰骤谙。金埒鸣鞭矢中六，琼楼载咏月逢三。柳垂碧线晴烟掩，草展文茵晓露含。缅忆当年承渥泽，时光迁易意何堪。
evidence.summary: Mounted archery in the third month before 含辉楼: it confirms a riding track and lawn in front of the tower, willow-lined. S220 says archery moved here from 出入贤良门 under Daoguang (e.g. four times in the fourth month of 1830). QC13-N01 is the plan's 撒马道 riding track.

evidence.title: 含辉楼: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
昔年马射沐恩隆，今岁今宵事岂同。疎柳清池仍此地，华镫鼓乐触予衷。承欢伊始层楼畅，因便何妨御苑东。灿烂鱼龙争曼衍，欣看月上不生风（含辉楼者，昔年马射之
地也。元夕后一日，张镫陈戏，恭侍安舆，是日午前，多风，入座之后，遂尔恬息，慈颜怡悦，朕亦蔚欣）。
evidence.summary: Daoguang, 1823: lanterns and plays for the dowager; his note calls the tower the old riding-archery ground.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 含辉楼
evidence.summary: Given to Prince Yongxuan about 1773 as 含晖园, to Princess Zhuangjing in 1801, returned in 1811 as 南园, when 联辉楼 was moved here from 西爽村. Main tower two storeys of seven bays, with a riding track 撤马道 south of it and 招凉榭, a five-bay open hall, on an islet. Its gates are 环翠 and the city-style south gate with Jiaqing's plaques 护松扉 and 排青幌. North of it lie 清夏斋 and 延英论道.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 撒马道.
